mapper.insert: INSERT INTO browsing_history (user_id, topic_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{topicId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT bh.id, bh.created_at AS viewedAt, t.id AS topicId, t.title, t.view_count AS viewCount, t.reply_count AS replyCount, t.like_count AS likeCount, t.created_at AS topicCreatedAt, u.username AS authorName, c.name AS categoryName FROM browsing_history bh JOIN forum_topics t ON bh.topic_id = t.id AND t.status = 1 JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN forum_categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE bh.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY bh.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM browsing_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM browsing_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND topic_id = #{topicId}
